Package model.creature

Class Skeleton

java.lang.Object
model.creature.Creature
model.creature.Skeleton
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Skeleton extends Creature
Represents the generic shooting creature Skeleton.

Extends the Creature class. Skeletons have varying statistics depending on which dungeon it is in.

  • Constructor Details

    • Skeleton

      public Skeleton(int order, HashSet<DungeonModifier> dungeonModifiers)
      Constructs a Skeleton depending on the current Dungeon and DungeonModifiers.

      Constructs a Skeleton Creature via the Creature constructor. Its characteristics depend on the order of the Dungeon.

      Parameters:
      order - the order of the dungeon currently being challenged.
      dungeonModifiers - the list of DungeonModifiers of the current Floor.

  • Method Details

    • tick

      public boolean tick(Floor floor)
      Reduces the Skeleton's move cooldown by one. Once it reaches 0, it resets the curCooldown to the moveInterval and takes its turn. If the Player is adjacent to the Skeleton on its turn, the Skeleton skips and holds its turn, else, if the Player is aligned orthogonally, the Skeleton fires an Arrow through the Floor.createArrow(int, int, double, Direction) method. else, the Skeleton moves to a valid adjacent space closer to the Player. The Skeleton also triggers any Structure Idle effects if it does not move during its turn. With the DungeonModifier, FASTER_SKELETONS, on, it can fire an arrow after moving as well.
      Specified by:
      tick in class Creature
      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the Skeleton is on, allows the Skeleton to search and move on it.
      Returns:
      true if the Skeleton died as a result of its turn.
